description: This file is a shell script containing a series of Git commands and tests related to sparse checkout scope in a Git repository. It defines tests to verify sparse checkout features such as pattern matching, branch merging, and blob fetching.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures Git options for the test environment.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output or a file is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output or files.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Sets up a new Git repository for testing.
